original.name: quadraticChar_card_card
original.statement: ringChar F ≠ 2) {F' : Type*} [Field F'] [Fintype F'] [DecidableEq F'] (hF' : ringChar F' ≠ 2) (h : ringChar F' ≠ ringChar F) : quadraticChar F (Fintype.card F') = quadraticChar F' (quadraticChar F (-1) * Fintype.card F)
